scientific_integrity: A complete combinatorial argument and standard-library finite checks are supplied. Finite tests are not an infinite proof. No independent validation or priority determination has occurred.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed summand count only; no growing-weight uniformity, no least quasipolynomial-period assertion, no natural-density assertion for the unrestricted set. The 2006 Ray–Cooper article was available in abstract rather than full text, leaving residual bibliographic risk.
title: Fixed-weight Zeckendorf–Niven strata: Pisano-polynomial counts and an adjacency correction
